messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 6(9)

Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures. 9. By 14 July 2025, and every five years thereafter, Member States shall provide the data and information referred to in paragraph 5, including information to the effect that none of the events referred to in paragraph 5 has occurred, for every category of machinery or related products which is included in Annex I or which is not included in Annex I where that non-inclusion is a cause of concern for the Member State.

response.text:

Member States | shall provide the data and information referred to in paragraph 5 | every category of machinery or related products not included in Annex I | where that non-inclusion is a cause of concern for the Member State | or which is not included in Annex I where that non-inclusion is a cause of concern for the Member State
Member States | shall provide information to the effect that none of the events referred to in paragraph 5 has occurred | every category of machinery or related products covered by the reporting duty | by 14 July 2025, and every five years thereafter | including information to the effect that none of the events referred to in paragraph 5 has occurred, for every category of machinery or related products
Member States' reporting obligation | recurs | every five years | after 14 July 2025 | every five years thereafter
